This interactive causal-loop diagram shows the technical-debt "doom loop" -- shortcuts accumulate, the legacy codebase grows harder to change, harder-to-change code invites more shortcuts -- along with three clickable leverage-point interventions that break the loop. Learning objective: given the technical-debt reinforcing loop, the learner will identify which leverage-point intervention would most effectively break the cycle for a system already showing signs of being a legacy system (Bloom: Analyzing).
